records.text: Ian Ward’s Politico profile framed Neff as grappling with whether his “maximalist position on free speech” helped conspiracy theories flourish; Carlson explicitly identified this as Ward’s framing, not Neff’s wording.
records.speaker: Ian Ward

appearances.snippet: This is a profile of Blake Neff from Politico. Neff confessed to grappling in a roundabout way with the possibility that his maximalist position on free speech has ... helped foster the conditions that have allowed rank conspiracism to flourish. I've reflected on this often, he said, sipping a s'mores-flavored cold brew on a leather couch in the studio's green room.
